description.p: Typst IDE is a local editor for Typst. Write documents in a modern editor with live preview, and keep your files on your own machine: no account, no cloud, no browser.

ul.li: Live preview rendered by the same compiler as Typst.app
Click in the preview to jump to the matching source position
Preview automatically follows the editor cursor
Project file manager with drag & drop, imports and images
Markers (TODO, FIXME, …) highlighted in the editor, with a marker book
Global and per-project notes, templates, history
PDF export, bibliography helpers, configuration import/export
JSON themes with light and dark variants

screenshot.caption: Editing a Typst document with the live preview
The marker book collecting TODO and FIXME comments

description.p: This release adds JSON themes, automatic system language detection, a persistent scratch draft, and the new application identifier.

ul.li: Choose light and dark variants from JSON theme files in the Help menu.
The current theme is included in the configuration export and restored on import.
The interface follows the system locale, with English as fallback.
Text typed without an open project is saved as a draft and restored at startup.
The app identifier is now io.github.gnoooo.typst-ide, with automatic migration of existing data.
Improved Typst syntax highlighting, PDF export feedback, and performance.
Fixed Ctrl+E, bibliography refresh, autosave races, modal validation, and package caching.
